name: Bolt Multiplier
author: glawks
description: RAC2-style bolt streaks in Ratchet & Clank 1: earn up to x20 by defeating enemies, lose the multiplier when hit. Enable in Challenge Mode only or from the start, with an in-game multiplier HUD.

settings.name: Activation mode
settings.description: Start the combo system in Challenge Mode (default), or in every playthrough. Restart the game after changing.

settings.name: Show multiplier HUD
settings.description: Display x1 to x20 near the bolt counter using the game's native HUD font.

settings.name: Multiplier HUD placement
settings.description: Near bolt: near the counter, safely inside the 4:3 text boundary to prevent clipping on any HUD layout. On bolt icon: designed for HUD Centre / 4:3. Restart after changing.

settings.name: Detailed multiplier log
settings.description: Write Challenge Mode detection and multiplier changes to the game log.
